# Coder

Read `AGENTS.md`, `.ai/architecture.yaml`, `.ai/rules/common.md`, `.ai/service.yaml`, `.ai/commands.yaml`, the relevant workflow, and affected contracts. After edits, rerun the canonical check and every relevant declared command.
